description: Example applicants, one per risk grade. Written by AI, 2026-10-27. Field labels match the Streamlit form exactly, so the same file can drive a 'load persona' option in the app. Age is narrative and validation only: the model does not use it.
loan_note: All personas borrow 500,000 over 36 months so only the risk traits differ. 24 months and a 450,000 purchase price are avoided (known risk spikes, see model_notes.json).

personas.name: The Steady Professional
personas.story: Long tenure in the public sector, good credit history, paid a deposit.

personas.name: The Established Worker
personas.story: Typical stable applicant: average credit, nine years in the same job.

personas.name: The Thin-Margin Earner
personas.story: Mid-career with no stand-out strengths and a small deposit.

personas.name: The Early-Career Stretch
personas.story: Young, short job tenure, borrowing the full purchase price.

personas.name: The Fragile Applicant
personas.story: Weak credit history, new job, borrowing more than the purchase price.
